svg.title: BucksNode.com — Earn Free Cash
svg.desc: A redrawn blue wireless router with gently rounded corners, parallel vertical edges, consistent perspective, and only a right antenna, surrounded by dollar bills and coins, without a face, arms, or legs. The left-middle star and small upper-left bill have been removed, and the larger bill moved up. Earn and Free Cash match the supplied green color, #77BA53. The router is 25 percent wider with its height unchanged. The cream bucksnode.com wordmark appears in an inset badge aligned to the front plane. Earn is raised above Free Cash. The pale-yellow circular backdrop has 85 percent opacity, and all dollar bills are fully opaque; the outer background is fully transparent.
